## Leading Electrical Contractor Servicing
## Commercial, Industrial, and Residential in Iowa

Founded over 75 years ago and headquartered in Des Moines, IA,
Baker Electric is a preeminent full service electrical contractor providing network cabling,
underground installations, traffic signalization, and service.
 Additionally, Baker Electric also provides energy-efficient services including conservation, energy
audits, and lighting retrofits.  

## [Service and Repair][28]

[[Night view of skyline with lightening striking]][29]

When you call Baker Electric after regular office hours or even on a holiday, our phone will ALWAYS
be answered by a person. 

[Learn more.][30]

## [Commercial][31]

[[Commercial building exterior view]][32]

We provide electrical services to all types of projects including, government, commerical, schools,
industrial and underground.

[Learn more.][33]

## [Residential][34]

[[Residential home with ceiling light, lamps and customized wall lights]][35]

Our electricians specialize in electrical design, sales, installations, construction, maintenance
and electrical repair services.

[Learn more.][36]

## [technology services][37]

[[Baker Panduit ITS Voice Data unit]][38]

Our staff has all the training, credentials, certifications and experience to handle all types and
sizes of installations from small companies to the largest corporations. 

[Learn more.][39]

## [Lighting][40]

[[Exterior night view of a commercial building with custom lighting]][41]

Our electricians and designers will offer cost-competitive solutions to your existing lighting
needs, as well as green lighting performance.

[Learn more.][42]

## [Traffic, Underground & Signalization][43]

[[Night view of a highway with cars driving]][44]

Baker Electric provides integrated traffic control systems, general roadway lighting and custom
streetscapes.

[Learn more.][45]

## [Energy Services][46]

[[Science Center Client exterior view of building]][47]

We help ensure customers are saving on electricity, lighting and other costs. We begin with a full
assessment of energy use levels, and invariably, we will identify energy losses.

[Learn more.][48]

## [Design Build][49]

[[Baker Electric signage on building with crane in background]][50]

We use the latest Web-based and CAD technologies, and work closely with architectural and
engineering firms to build unparalleled electrical structures.

[Learn more.][51]

## [Prefabrication][52]

[[View of Baker Electric prefabrication plant ]][53]

We are among a handful of companies in the country to operate a separate prefabrication plant to
help save you money on your projects.

[Learn more.][54]

## Baker Electric, Inc.

Nous aidons les clients industriels, commerciaux et résidentiels à rendre leurs entreprises et leurs
maisons plus économes en énergie, plus confortables, plus sûres et plus durables.

[En savoir plus][27]

>

rating, and protection scheme wrong is one of the costliest mistakes in electrical design. Our
busbar cluster walks through the full design process, from initial sizing to thermal withstand under
fault conditions.

[Busbar Sizing, Ampacity & Protection]

* Verify [phase-to-phase clearance per IEC 61439][52] for switchgear and panel assemblies.

This training provides specific knowledge about soil classifications, protective systems, and
recognition of excavation hazards to enable workers to take prompt corrective measures to eliminate
possible hazards.

The designated Competent Person is responsible for continual observational safety checks of the work

Philosophy

#### Dedicated to a Successful Safety Culture

## Safety Philosophy

It is our belief that every employee is key to the success of a work environment that promotes and
prioritizes safety. To achieve this goal, CCS has a full time Safety Officer dedicated to the
continued training and education of each of our employees to contribute to a successful safety
culture. With the direct support of management, CCS establishes and maintains a safety-first
environment with deliberate action.

### All field management is a Certified Competent Person in compliance with OSHA standard 1926.

This training provides specific knowledge about soil classifications, protective systems, and
recognition of excavation hazards to enable workers to take prompt corrective measures to eliminate
possible hazards.

The designated Competent Person is responsible for continual observational safety checks of the work
operations, and to enforce the safety policies and procedures. OSHAâ€™s excavation standards require
CCS to have a Competent Person on site during any active excavation , and all employees trained in
the hazards of trenching & excavation work.

**By being in compliance with this standard, we not only protect our employees but also avoid costly
OSHA citations & penalties.**


[ Read The CCS Safety Philosophy ][28]

> Our customers appreciate the work you SAFELY completed and I do also.

Beverly Paull Grizzi
Raleigh, NC

> I have had the pleasure of working with your crew in Clemson over the past month. I just wanted to
> let you know they are an outstanding crew. They were quick to help me when I needed Just wanted to
> brag on them a bit.

Jeremy Jetton of Clemson University
Raleigh, NC

> I just wanted to take a minute and thank CCS, for your help in correcting the duct bank issue at
> Greek Village this past week. I especially want to thank Mike and his foreman Johnny for their
> hard work, professionalism, attention to detail and their safety culture. A group having all four
> of these characteristics represents a company that re-enforces these traits and a company that I
> am proud to have as part of our Team on future projects.

Skip McGlamery of Fred Smith Company
Raleigh, NC

# The Smart Way to Manage Chronic Conditions™

CCS is redefining chronic care management by combining products and supplies with clinical
education, monitoring and coaching, making it easier for those living with diabetes to manage their
condition.
[ Learn More ][46]
THE CCS DIFFERENCE

## Helping people start and stay on therapy

#### 30 Years Strong

We've consistently delivered a breadth of products accurately and on time for decades.

#### Real People, Real Help

Our dedicated team guides you personally with your device setup.

#### Smart Support

Data-driven tech ensures personalized care and seamless health management.

### Getting Started

## Fast-Track Your First Order

After receiving your doctor's referral, our New Customer Enrollment team swiftly handles insurance
checks and confirms your initial order.
[ What to Expect ][47]
Product Coverage

## Products you know and trust

As one of the largest suppliers for Medicare, we partner with top manufacturers to offer a wide
product range, ensuring you get your preferred device on time.
* Extensive Product Range
* Quick Device Delivery
* All Major Manufacturers

 

[ Browse Products ][48]

to ensure you’re prepared from day one.
* Comprehensive Guidance
* Quick Troubleshooting
* Tailored Support

 

[ Schedule My Session ][50]

Our Mission

## Redefining Chronic Care Management

Chronic Care Solutions is our name. We provide top-notch products and teach you how to use them,
aiming to improve outcomes, reduce acute episodes, and make care management simpler and safer.
* Quality Products
* Hands-on Teaching
* Personalized Coaching

 

[ Discover the CCS Difference ][51]
LivingConnected®

## Comprehensive Care, Personalized Touch

Collaborative, evidence-based diabetes care. Real-time glycemic insights and guidance for improved
member health and reduced complications.
* Easy-to-use platform 
* Smart biometric devices
* 24/7 live monitoring, intervention & coaching
* Zero Unnecessary Costs

[ Learn More ][52]

## Interested in partnering with us?

CCS partners with providers, health plans, manufacturers and employers to enhance care outcomes for
populations living with chronic conditions.

 

[

### Providers

Connect patients with CCS and your product of choice for reliable, trustworthy delivery and
comprehensive insurance coverage.

][53] [ Learn More ][54] [

Optimize therapy adherence, reduce overall diabetes spend, increase member engagement and improve
health outcomes.

][55] [ Learn More ][56] [

### Manufacturers

Boost patient compliance with reliable delivery of supplies plus access to education and coaching.

][57] [ Learn More ][58] [

### Employers

Increase employee morale, productivity and health while reducing healthcare costs and absenteeism.

][59] [ Learn More ][60]

### Your Vision, Our Expertise.

Have a unique approach to diabetes care? Join hands with us for a personalized, impactful
partnership.

[ Tell me More ][61]

Rick Stevens

~1000 tokens per second, you have the opportunity to optimize all parts of the agent together,

Scott Wu

and performance are the bottleneck. What we've built with Cerebras solves that: by splitting the
inference workload across Trainium and the CS-3, and EFA connecting them, each system does what it's
best at. The result is inference that's an order of magnitude faster and higher performance than
what's available today.

David Brown

CT Strategic Partners connects founders of established businesses with serious, well-capitalized
buyers, privately, and on your terms. No public listings. No tire kickers. Just qualified
conversations with people who understand what you’ve built. **The buyer pays our fee. You owe

Our Belief

## Most founders don’t need a broker. *They need the right partner.*

The Problem

## The options most founders get offered don’t feel right.

Maybe you’ve thought about selling. Or maybe you just know the business can’t get to the next level
the way things are now.

You need capital, or operational support, or a partner who’s done this before. But brokers want to
list you publicly and take a percentage of your sale price. Private equity sounds like a world that
wasn’t built for you. And most buyers just want to strip it down and flip it.

**CT Strategic Partners doesn’t charge you a dime.** We don’t take a cut of your sale. And we never
list or shop your business publicly. Your employees, your customers, and your competitors won’t know
you’re exploring this unless you decide to tell them.

We work with a vetted network of **100+ private equity firms, family offices, search funds, and
strategic acquirers** who buy businesses to grow them, not gut them. Whether you’re looking for a
full exit, a [recapitalization][11] where you take chips off the table and stay involved, or a
growth partner who brings capital and operational muscle, we match you with the right fit.

Many of our buyers offer **rollover equity**, meaning you take a meaningful payout now and share in
the upside as the business grows. We work alongside our capital partners on every deal, so we only
bring you opportunities we genuinely believe in.

There’s no prep work on your end. No parade of tire kickers to entertain. We learn your business
through a single conversation, and if there’s a fit, we make one or two introductions. Most deals
close in **60 to 120 days**, not the 9 to 12 months an auction process takes. You move when you’re
ready, whether that’s three months or three years. We’ll be here either way.

## Honest answers to what you’re probably thinking.

Is this a listing service?

No. We don’t list businesses for sale or represent sellers in a traditional sense. We work as a
sourcing partner to a small group of institutional buyers. When we connect you with a buyer, it’s
because your business genuinely fits what they’re looking for, not because we’re trying to generate
a fee.

Will my business be publicly listed?

Not through us. Confidentiality is foundational to how we operate. We don’t publish business
details, and we don’t share information without your explicit approval.

Can I just talk to you without committing to anything?

Absolutely. Many of the business owners we speak with are just exploring. Some end up selling. Some
don’t. Either way, it’s a useful conversation to have, even if the timing isn’t right today. There’s
no exclusivity contract, no tail fee, and no obligation at any stage.

What does this cost me?

Our capital partners compensate us when a deal closes. There’s no fee to you at any stage. If
nothing happens, nothing is owed. Our fee is a percentage of the final sale price, paid by the
buyer, which means our incentives are aligned with yours on getting a top of market number.

Who are your buyers?

Typically private equity firms, family offices, search funders, or strategic acquirers in your
industry. These are experienced operators who’ve done this before and understand how to work with
founders through a transition. Many of our buyers offer rollover equity so you can keep upside as
the business grows.

retain the existing team, your people are part of what makes the business valuable. We make sure
this is on the table from day one.

The Smart Way to Sell Your Business in 2026

# You Built Something Real.What Happens Next Should Reflect That.

CT Strategic Partners connects founders of established businesses with serious, well-capitalized
buyers, privately, and on your terms. No public listings. No tire kickers. Just qualified
conversations with people who understand what you’ve built. **The buyer pays our fee. You owe
nothing at any stage.**

[Start a Confidential Conversation →][9] [How It Works][10]
Our Belief

## Most founders don’t need a broker. *They need the right partner.*

The Problem

## The options most founders get offered don’t feel right.

Maybe you’ve thought about selling. Or maybe you just know the business can’t get to the next level
the way things are now.

You need capital, or operational support, or a partner who’s done this before. But brokers want to
list you publicly and take a percentage of your sale price. Private equity sounds like a world that
wasn’t built for you. And most buyers just want to strip it down and flip it.

**CT Strategic Partners doesn’t charge you a dime.** We don’t take a cut of your sale. And we never
list or shop your business publicly. Your employees, your customers, and your competitors won’t know
you’re exploring this unless you decide to tell them.

We work with a vetted network of **100+ private equity firms, family offices, search funds, and
strategic acquirers** who buy businesses to grow them, not gut them. Whether you’re looking for a
full exit, a [recapitalization][11] where you take chips off the table and stay involved, or a
growth partner who brings capital and operational muscle, we match you with the right fit.

Many of our buyers offer **rollover equity**, meaning you take a meaningful payout now and share in
the upside as the business grows. We work alongside our capital partners on every deal, so we only
bring you opportunities we genuinely believe in.

There’s no prep work on your end. No parade of tire kickers to entertain. We learn your business
through a single conversation, and if there’s a fit, we make one or two introductions. Most deals
close in **60 to 120 days**, not the 9 to 12 months an auction process takes. You move when you’re
ready, whether that’s three months or three years. We’ll be here either way.

Industries We Cover

## Established businesses with real revenue and real history.

Founder-owned and family-owned businesses across the U.S. and Canada. Companies with loyal
customers, experienced teams, and strong reputations. Not startups. Businesses that work. Revenue
typically $1M to $50M, flexible for the right fit.

Common Questions

## Honest answers to what you’re probably thinking.

Is this a listing service?

No. We don’t list businesses for sale or represent sellers in a traditional sense. We work as a
sourcing partner to a small group of institutional buyers. When we connect you with a buyer, it’s
because your business genuinely fits what they’re looking for, not because we’re trying to generate
a fee.

Will my business be publicly listed?

Not through us. Confidentiality is foundational to how we operate. We don’t publish business
details, and we don’t share information without your explicit approval.

Can I just talk to you without committing to anything?

Absolutely. Many of the business owners we speak with are just exploring. Some end up selling. Some
don’t. Either way, it’s a useful conversation to have, even if the timing isn’t right today. There’s
no exclusivity contract, no tail fee, and no obligation at any stage.

What does this cost me?

Our capital partners compensate us when a deal closes. There’s no fee to you at any stage. If
nothing happens, nothing is owed. Our fee is a percentage of the final sale price, paid by the
buyer, which means our incentives are aligned with yours on getting a top of market number.

Who are your buyers?

Typically private equity firms, family offices, search funders, or strategic acquirers in your
industry. These are experienced operators who’ve done this before and understand how to work with
founders through a transition. Many of our buyers offer rollover equity so you can keep upside as
the business grows.

What happens to my team?

This is one of the first things we discuss with partners. Most of our capital partners want to
retain the existing team, your people are part of what makes the business valuable. We make sure
this is on the table from day one.

About Us

## Built by people who respect what you’ve built.

We started CT Strategic Partners because too many good businesses get overlooked or get bad advice
when the owner starts thinking about what’s next.

We grew up around tradespeople. We’ve worked with operating businesses and institutional capital. We
know what it takes to build something from nothing, and we know what it looks like when the wrong
buyer gets involved.

The firm was built to be the partner we wished existed for founders: someone who tells it straight,
protects your privacy, and connects you with buyers who will treat your business and your people the
right way.

Great things in business are never done by one person. They’re done by a team of people. We have
that dynamic group.

## meet prescribed standards and minimize risk

## Increase the competitiveness of your business with technical standards.

## You will stand out from the competition with engineering standards! Standards will provide you
## with a framework for production, processes and quality, which will lead to increased efficiency,
## reduced errors as well as improved customer confidence in your products or services.

## Live in harmony with the global market.

## Standards are key to international trade. Using harmonized standards, you can easily expand into
## new markets, make products and services available worldwide and gain the trust of foreign
## customers.

## Ecology and sustainability - European and International standards strive to protect the

## help businesses reduce costs

### Video engineering, Metallurgy, Petroleum technologies, Agriculture, Rubber and Plastics,
### Buildings, Civil engineering, Energy and heat transfer engineering, Quality management
### standards, Safety rules standards... 

### This classification is absolutely clear and will help you choose the right standards. 

### If you need more information about canceled standards or their replacement do not hesitate to
### [contact us][42].

### **European Standards** is an expression of requirements for products, processes or services to
### meet the requirement of fitness for a particular purpose.

 

EN Standards have got a positive impact on facilitating the free movement of goods in international
trade, seeking to rationalize production, helps to promote environmental protection and
competitiveness, ensuring adequate consumer protection in the Internal Market.

Currently, EN qualified technical recommendations are not binding and their use is voluntary.

EN standard, such as publicly available documents, is accessible at all stages of formation and use
in practice.

These **European Standards**, unlike legislation, which may occur without consultation and consent
of all the concerned documents, when addressing fundamental questions agreed upon by all
stakeholders.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

into a single forecast you can act on.

  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch

  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

### Standards

[See All][185]
[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

Various types of pipe fittings are available in plumbing systems for different purposes and
functions. A pipe fitting is used in plumbing system to join multiple pipes of same size or
different sizes, to regulate the flow or to measure the flow.

the comprehensive economic benefit is 5-6 times that of steel pipe without excavation, and it is not

MADE FOR REAL^{}

# Professional Cable Management

MADE FOR REAL^{}

Professional Cable Management

[Cable Ties and Fixings]

## Cable Ties

Cable ties have to be able to meet the most varied demands these days as they are used in the widest
range of operations – from the simple bundling of cables with cable ties to the absolutely specific
use of cable ties under extreme conditions.

[Heat shrink tubing]

## Heat Shrink Tubing

You are looking for the heat shrink tubing meeting your application requirements best? The key
factors to which we owe our success are the unique and quite specific properties of our heat shrink
tubing.

[Cable protection conduits]

## Cable Protection Conduits

Perfect cable protection with flexible conduits and fittings, braided sleeving, spiral binding and
cable protection tubing ...

[Cable management products]

## Cable management

Whether for the desk or for industry, screwable or self-adhesive, whether clip, conduit or mounting
base, find the right cable management solution for your application now.

[Electrical Installation]

## Electrical Installation

Professional and skilful electrical installation requires not only well-trained specialists, but
also a well thought-out range of products. To help electricians and engineers make their work more
safe and efficient...

[Cable labels, wire labels for industrial identification]

## Industrial Identification and Self-Adhesive Labels

You are looking for cable labels, wire labels or cable tags? HellermannTyton offers a wide range of
identification solutions for industrial use.

[Cable tie guns]

## Cable tie guns

From manual and pneumatic cable tie guns to automatic cable tie guns, Hellermanntyton offers a wide
range of cable tie tensioning tools for a variety of requirements. Always reliable and comfortable
and ideal for long-term use.

[RFID technology]

## RFID tracking

HellermannTyton has for many years manufactured a range of identification products that give both
human readable and barcoded identification. To complete the range of asset management identification
HellermannTyton has introduced a new range of RFID tags and cable accessories. The ties are
especially suited for securing, serialisation, tracking and identification of products in the areas
of resource management, electrical inspection, inventory, distribution and rental services as well
as for easy management of maintenance and repair routines.

## The sustainable choice in cable management

90 years leading the way in smart cable management: More than ever, HellermannTyton is committed to
innovation that supports responsible consumption and production in line with global climate targets.

Our greatest contribution to reducing environmental impact lies in the carbon emissions of the raw
materials we use to make our products. That's why Source is focused on sustainable materials and
design.

[Discover our Source product strategy][185]

### Biodegradable ties

Our new microplastic-free ties are designed to fully biodegrade at the end of their useful life.

][186]
[ [Exhibition image]

### Custom Solutions

Developing innovative new products is at the heart of what we do, connect with your local innovation
hub to create a solution to your cable management problem.

][187]

### Advanced EMI Shielding

Lightweight. Flexible. Highly efficient. Twist-In-EMIZ delivers superior EMI protection.

][188]
[ [Trefoil cable cleats]

### Trefoil cable cleats

Precise, stable, certified. Engineered for demanding installations. Built for critical environments.

][189]
[ [Infographic focus topic]

### On track to sustainability

Rail travel is the most sustainable form of mass-transport. Discover how cable management is
supporting rail investment.

][190]

### Experience us at first hand

We regularly exhibit at industry trade shows worldwide. Find out where you can meet us next near

## Sustainability at HellermannTyton

We are committed to reducing the emissions generated by our business, whilst supporting our
customers meet their sustainability ambitions.

# Professional Cable Management

MADE FOR REAL^{}

Professional Cable Management

[Cable Ties and Fixings]

## Cable Ties

Cable ties have to be able to meet the most varied demands these days as they are used in the widest
range of operations – from the simple bundling of cables with cable ties to the absolutely specific
use of cable ties under extreme conditions.

[Heat shrink tubing]

## Heat Shrink Tubing

You are looking for the heat shrink tubing meeting your application requirements best? The key
factors to which we owe our success are the unique and quite specific properties of our heat shrink
tubing.

[Cable protection conduits]

## Cable Protection Conduits

Perfect cable protection with flexible conduits and fittings, braided sleeving, spiral binding and
cable protection tubing ...

[Cable management products]

## Cable management

Whether for the desk or for industry, screwable or self-adhesive, whether clip, conduit or mounting
base, find the right cable management solution for your application now.

[Electrical Installation]

## Electrical Installation

Professional and skilful electrical installation requires not only well-trained specialists, but
also a well thought-out range of products. To help electricians and engineers make their work more
safe and efficient...

[Cable labels, wire labels for industrial identification]

## Industrial Identification and Self-Adhesive Labels

You are looking for cable labels, wire labels or cable tags? HellermannTyton offers a wide range of
identification solutions for industrial use.

[Cable tie guns]

## Cable tie guns

From manual and pneumatic cable tie guns to automatic cable tie guns, Hellermanntyton offers a wide
range of cable tie tensioning tools for a variety of requirements. Always reliable and comfortable
and ideal for long-term use.

[RFID technology]

## RFID tracking

HellermannTyton has for many years manufactured a range of identification products that give both
human readable and barcoded identification. To complete the range of asset management identification
HellermannTyton has introduced a new range of RFID tags and cable accessories. The ties are
especially suited for securing, serialisation, tracking and identification of products in the areas
of resource management, electrical inspection, inventory, distribution and rental services as well
as for easy management of maintenance and repair routines.

## The sustainable choice in cable management

90 years leading the way in smart cable management: More than ever, HellermannTyton is committed to
innovation that supports responsible consumption and production in line with global climate targets.

Our greatest contribution to reducing environmental impact lies in the carbon emissions of the raw
materials we use to make our products. That's why Source is focused on sustainable materials and
design.

## Get to know us

icotek, manufacturer of smart cable management systems, has been developing high quality innovative
solutions since 1995. icotek's split cable glands and EMC solutions are ideal for today's mechanical
engineering and plant construction industries.



From our World Headquarters in Eschach, Germany, and our global offices in Europe, Asia and America,
we distribute our patented cable management systems around the world.



Our ever expanding portfolio of products includes cable entry systems for pre-terminated and
non-terminated cables as well as a full range of EMC shielding solutions.

With our completely split [KEL cable entry systems][21], pre-terminated cables with diameters from 1
– 75 mm can be routed quickly and sealed securely with up to IP66/IP68/UL Type 4X*. It also provides
great benefits whether you are retrofitting or maintaining your application.

The [split cable glands KVT and QVT][22] utilise the same split design and are quickly assembled.
These products perfectly provide cable management and routing solutions for prefabricated cables
with e.g. D-Sub or PROFIBUS connectors.

The compact [cable entry plates][23] are ideal for routing standard cables without connectors from
1.5 to 22 mm in diameter with minimum space requirements. High certified sealing rates up to IP68/UL

engineering and plant construction industries.



From our World Headquarters in Eschach, Germany, and our global offices in Europe, Asia and America,
we distribute our patented cable management systems around the world.



Our ever expanding portfolio of products includes cable entry systems for pre-terminated and
non-terminated cables as well as a full range of EMC shielding solutions.

With our completely split [KEL cable entry systems][21], pre-terminated cables with diameters from 1
– 75 mm can be routed quickly and sealed securely with up to IP66/IP68/UL Type 4X*. It also provides

shield clamps][30] are made for reliable and effective earthing of high frequency interferences and

news, and more.

company status.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Pioneer Industrial Instruments — our products, services,

Who is a leading manufacturer of industrial cable trays in Pune, India? +
Pioneer Cable Trays is a premier manufacturer of heavy-duty industrial cable management systems.

high-capacity manufacturing facility located in the Sonaee Industrial Estate in Pirangut, Pune.
What safety standards and international certifications do Pioneer cable trays meet? +
To guarantee absolute industrial safety and structural integrity under heavy cable loads, all cable
management systems manufactured by Pioneer are UL Certified and strictly conform to the
international IEC 61537:2023 testing standard.
What types of cable management systems does Pioneer manufacture? +

Features

## Everything you need to pitch with confidence

From deck feedback to financial research, PitchGrade gives founders and analysts the tools to make
smarter decisions.

### AI Deck Review

Get a detailed score, structured feedback, and actionable suggestions on every slide of your pitch
deck.

### Investor Matching

See how your deck fits with 20+ top investors like Sequoia, a16z, and YC — or enter your own target
investor.

### Research AgentNew

An autonomous agent that builds DCF models, pulls SEC filings, runs peer comps, and writes
investment theses — without you lifting a finger.

[Try it free →][2]

### Slide Generator

Generate styled, investor-ready PPTX slide decks from a prompt — powered by AI and ready to
download.

### Live Financial Data

Real-time stock quotes, income statements, analyst consensus, and insider activity for thousands of
companies.

### Company Comparison

Compare up to 4 companies side by side on market cap, revenue, margins, P/E ratio, and more.

How It Works

## Three steps to better pitches

1

### Upload your deck

Paste your pitch text or upload a PDF/PPTX. Our AI reads every slide.

2

### Get scored feedback

Receive a score across 6 dimensions plus concrete, actionable suggestions.

3

### Rewrite and improve

Let AI rewrite your deck based on the feedback, or refine it yourself.

New — Agent Tier

## Your autonomous financial research team

Give it a task. It plans, searches, models, and synthesizes — delivering a full investment memo
while you focus on decisions that matter.

## About Our Company

**Trusted Manufacturer of Industrial Storage Solutions Since 1990**

PRK Steel Products Pvt. Ltd., established in 1990, is a leading manufacturer and supplier of
premium-quality industrial storage systems. Headquartered in Faridabad, Haryana, we specialise in a
wide range of storage and material handling solutions designed for warehouses, factories, logistics
hubs, and industrial units across Pan India.

With over 30 years of industry experience, we are known for our durable products, innovative
designs, and customised services that help businesses maximise space and streamline operations.

**Premium Quality**

Our products are made using high-grade steel and undergo strict quality checks to ensure strength,
safety, and long life.

**Customized Solutions**

We provide fully customised racking systems, mezzanine floors, and shelving units designed to meet
your specific space and load requirements.

**Nationwide Service**

From consultation to delivery and installation, we serve clients across the country with dedicated
support and reliable service.

[Learn More About Us][76]

Explore our wide range of high-quality industrial storage solutions designed to maximise space,
improve efficiency, and support heavy-duty performance. From pallet racks to mezzanine floors, we
offer durable, customisable systems trusted by industries across India for warehouses, factories,
logistics more.

# Leader in Premium Cable Management and Connectivity Solutions

Sealcon is the North American source for precision-engineered cable management solutions. Based in
Centennial, Colorado, we supply the highest-quality products—including Cable Glands, Circular
Connectors, Wire & Cable, Adapters, Enclosures, Enlargers, Conduit, Plugs and Accessories—to

SEMCOR offers a complete line of industrial products and solutions, plus a full-service fabrication

## Sometimes You Need More Than A Warehouse

[Conveying fluids][97] and materials around any industrial facility requires significant safety and
proper construction of handling components. That means we stock only high-quality products that are
engineered to provide the highest level of performance and reliability. With more than 35,000 square
feet of space, we also stock a wide range of sizes and specializations.

 

### **Material Handling**

At SEMCOR, we want to be your material handling company. We already have a diverse set of happy
customers here in the Midwest, and they keep coming back for more because we’re able to provide a
wide range of material handling equipment and specializations they need and solve their [material
handling issues][98].

[Conveyor belts][99], components, [belting services][100] and even equipment for belt fabrication
are all available from SEMCOR. Material handling problems can completely shut down any manufacturing
or development process, so we provide an emergency maintenance and sales team to help ensure our
customers’ troubles do as little financial harm as possible.

Ask us about all of the right fabrication equipment and support including adhesives, cement,
vulcanizers, belt lacers and cutters.

 

### **Fluid Handling**

[Fluid control solutions][101] from SEMCOR are specifically engineered to resist corrosion, abrasion
and vibration that can be common in industrial settings. We provide a full selection of [lined pipe
and fittings][102], [hose][103], [valves][104], [actuators][105], [controls][106], [expansion
joints][107], [sanitary products][108], [damper drives][109], [process instrumentation
products][110], [motors][111], and more.

Choosing SEMCOR as your fluid handling company means you’ll have 24/7 access to all the parts and
expertise you need. We offer goods from all of the top name brands including Baum, Resistoflex, ITT,
Kinetrol, HoseMaster, Sharpe, Habonim, and many more.

We can help you to control every aspect of your fluid handling.

 

### **Industrial Solutions and Customizations**

When you choose SEMCOR, you’ll get a variety of industrial services and [solutions][112] that are
designed to provide you with the best equipment to solve your problems. Every process and piece of
equipment we sell or provide is checked for quality. That allows us to give you excellent equipment
today and make improvements to offer better solutions tomorrow.

Our [fabrication][113] process is also automated to ensure our team starts your orders as quickly as
possible. No matter how you communicate your needs or where you’re located, we have the right sales
engineers to start diagnosing and addressing concerns.

Every time your line shuts down or your product fails to move, it costs you money. Let’s minimize
that loss by establishing a smart business partnership designed to keep your facilities running. In
the event there are problems, SEMCOR is proud to provide one of the Midwest’s best 24/7 emergency
response service.

 

### **Expert Knowledge for You**

SEMCOR staff has been selecting the right hose, conveyor belt or valve since 1907. We can match
products to meet your corrosion issues, recommend conveyor belts to facilitate the movement of
materials and select the right valves to keep liquids moving.

We’ve built our knowledge base by working closely with our customers and our key suppliers. Our
staff maintains its excellence through consistent training, certifications and testing. The more we
know, the more we can share with you and help keep your operations running efficiently.

material handling supplies, fluid handling supplies and other industrial solutions in the Midwest.
We’ve been [located in St. Louis][96] since our founding and have cultivated a team of local
experts.

SEMCOR offers a complete line of industrial products and solutions, plus a full-service fabrication
facility that can ensure all of your equipment is right for the job. Our customers turn to us time
and again because sometimes you need more than a warehouse.

 

## Sometimes You Need More Than A Warehouse

[Conveying fluids][97] and materials around any industrial facility requires significant safety and
proper construction of handling components. That means we stock only high-quality products that are
engineered to provide the highest level of performance and reliability. With more than 35,000 square
feet of space, we also stock a wide range of sizes and specializations.

 

### **Material Handling**

At SEMCOR, we want to be your material handling company. We already have a diverse set of happy
customers here in the Midwest, and they keep coming back for more because we’re able to provide a
wide range of material handling equipment and specializations they need and solve their [material
handling issues][98].

[Conveyor belts][99], components, [belting services][100] and even equipment for belt fabrication
are all available from SEMCOR. Material handling problems can completely shut down any manufacturing
or development process, so we provide an emergency maintenance and sales team to help ensure our
customers’ troubles do as little financial harm as possible.

Ask us about all of the right fabrication equipment and support including adhesives, cement,
vulcanizers, belt lacers and cutters.

 

### **Fluid Handling**

[Fluid control solutions][101] from SEMCOR are specifically engineered to resist corrosion, abrasion
and vibration that can be common in industrial settings. We provide a full selection of [lined pipe
and fittings][102], [hose][103], [valves][104], [actuators][105], [controls][106], [expansion
joints][107], [sanitary products][108], [damper drives][109], [process instrumentation
products][110], [motors][111], and more.

Choosing SEMCOR as your fluid handling company means you’ll have 24/7 access to all the parts and
expertise you need. We offer goods from all of the top name brands including Baum, Resistoflex, ITT,
Kinetrol, HoseMaster, Sharpe, Habonim, and many more.

We can help you to control every aspect of your fluid handling.

 

### **Industrial Solutions and Customizations**

When you choose SEMCOR, you’ll get a variety of industrial services and [solutions][112] that are
designed to provide you with the best equipment to solve your problems. Every process and piece of
equipment we sell or provide is checked for quality. That allows us to give you excellent equipment
today and make improvements to offer better solutions tomorrow.

Our [fabrication][113] process is also automated to ensure our team starts your orders as quickly as
possible. No matter how you communicate your needs or where you’re located, we have the right sales
engineers to start diagnosing and addressing concerns.

Every time your line shuts down or your product fails to move, it costs you money. Let’s minimize
that loss by establishing a smart business partnership designed to keep your facilities running. In
the event there are problems, SEMCOR is proud to provide one of the Midwest’s best 24/7 emergency
response service.

 

### **Expert Knowledge for You**

SEMCOR staff has been selecting the right hose, conveyor belt or valve since 1907. We can match
products to meet your corrosion issues, recommend conveyor belts to facilitate the movement of
materials and select the right valves to keep liquids moving.

We’ve built our knowledge base by working closely with our customers and our key suppliers. Our
staff maintains its excellence through consistent training, certifications and testing. The more we
know, the more we can share with you and help keep your operations running efficiently.
